boundary: Ten serial runs, 18 authored public synthetic development controls each; one shared M5 Max 128GB Mac. Each run uses a fresh model load, fixed greedy decoding, local MLX Metal, EOS and existing total/output budgets. Run timing includes repair, reconciliation and per-call grammar preparation; excludes initial model load and grammar tokenizer initialization. Case sums are not isolated latency or p95. Peak MLX allocation is not process RSS or available-memory requirement. Baseline/current algorithm versions are bound independently. Compact is current plus grammar plus lossless exact-text references, not a single-factor ablation for 4B/35B; 9B grammar-only control exists. Acceptance count is schema/source admission only. No independent semantic scoring, consumer comparison, microphone/ASR, energy or application promotion. Research-only 35B weights and grammar packages remain separate from application locks/defaults.
